claims: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT) on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II flight lasted 10 days.
The Artemis II flight took the crew around the Moon and back.
The Orion capsule reached speeds of approximately 25,000 mph upon re-entry.
NASA recovery teams were stationed in the Pacific to retrieve Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The splashdown occurred west of San Diego.
